import json,sys,http.client,subprocess,pathlib
sha="b57ddf678eb09bf4c7459196d46a2cbef7c793ce"
token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def get(path):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  c.request("GET",path,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
  r=c.getresponse();return r.status,r.read(200000)
 finally:c.close()
def check(label,ok):
 print(label+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
try:
 st,data=get("/healthz");check("LIVE_SHA",st==200 and json.loads(data).get("commit")==sha)
 st,script=get("/app.js");check("PUBLISH_DRAFT_BUTTON_LIVE",st==200 and b'tumblr.publish_draft' in script)
 st,html=get("/");check("OWNER_UI_LIVE",st==200 and b'id="chat-form"' in html)
 st,oauth=get("/oauth/status");check("OAUTH_STATUS_API",st==200 and isinstance(json.loads(oauth),dict))
 for pat in ("test_publisher_runtime.py","test_account_runtime.py","test_assistant.py"):
  proc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",pat,"-q"],
   capture_output=True,timeout=40)
  check("OFFLINE_"+pat,proc.returncode==0)
 print("REAL_TUMBLR_POSTS=ZERO",flush=True)
 print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS",flush=True)
except Exception as exc:
 print("ACCEPTANCE=FAIL:"+type(exc).__name__)
 sys.exit(42)
PY
